metadata.description: Curated demo subset of the c2d_arms dataset of 'Searching Qwen3-8B for where a coding ban lives'. One example = one common-random-numbers (CRN) slot (task, template, k); every predict_<arm> field is '<mechanism label>|<pass or fail>' for the program Qwen3-8B wrote in that arm on that slot (same uniforms in every arm).
metadata.selection: tasks T2 (default dijkstra) and T03 (default full_sort); templates W1-W5; CRN slots k 0-9, the slots on which every C2d arm was sampled: 2 tasks x 5 templates x 10 slots = 100 examples (the full dataset has 660 slots over 6 tasks; BAN, NEUTRAL, SUB_plain and ADD alpha 1 also have slots k 10-19 there)
metadata.quantisation: fp8_e4m3_w8a8_dynamic(per-output-channel weight scales, per-token activation scales; lm_head/embeddings/norms bf16)

conventions.block: block l = decoder block l (0-based); output = hidden_states[l+1]
conventions.S: [p1, spec_end): first token of 'Task:' .. last user token
conventions.k: generated position k = absolute P+k-1 (token k is the input; predicts k+1)
conventions.crn: slot (task, template, k) -> u_stream(task, template, k), identical in every arm

c2d_landings.rule: best alpha = alpha in {1,2} with the highest avoidance among those with pass rate >= 0.5; ties -> alpha 1

full_run_reference.note: values computed by the original pipeline on all 660 slots (results/c2d.json, method_out.json metadata)

T2.label: exploratory; not part of the frozen C2d rule

T03.label: exploratory; not part of the frozen C2d rule
